title: A tagents CLI spec
description: Every verb of a command line program as data. The node CLI, the contract generator and the Rust front door all read the one file this describes.

path.description: The words after the program name that select the verb, e.g. ["sessions", "recent"].

positionals.description: Positionals exactly as the usage text prints them: <ref-json-or-id>, [N], <words…>.

options.description: Option name without the dashes to its kind. The node CLI hands this to util.parseArgs unchanged.

required.description: Option names the verb refuses to run without.

summary.description: i18n key of the one-line summary. The text lives in the language catalogue, not here.

impl.description: Which program serves the verb: the Rust front door or the node CLI. The contract generator and the node CLI ignore it.

effect.description: Optional extra string kept for tooling that classifies verbs. The front door and the node CLI ignore it.
